title: Oracle SOA Developer
summary: Builds and runs the integrations that move data between business systems using Oracle's middleware: SOA Suite, Oracle Service Bus (OSB) and, more and more, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Sits in an integration or middleware team and works with the owners of the systems on both ends of each interface.
dailyDuties: Build BPEL and Mediator composites with database, file and FTP adapters
Build OSB proxy and business services and their transformations
Write XSLT and XQuery mappings for SOAP and REST messages
Deploy composites and configure JMS and data sources on WebLogic
Migrate older SOA and OSB flows to OIC
Monitor failed instances and fix production errors

skills.expectation: Build SOA composites with BPEL, Mediator and DB, File, FTP and JMS adapters
Build OSB proxy and business services, pipelines and transformations
Work with WSDL, XSD, XSLT and XPath in mappings and fault handling
Expose and consume REST services from SOA, OSB and OIC
Deploy composites and set up data sources and JMS resources on WebLogic
Query Oracle tables used by DB adapters and for checks
Build OIC integrations or migrate SOA and OSB flows to OIC
Agree interface designs with source and target system teams
Write PL/SQL procedures called from integrations
Write Java callouts and embedded code when needed
Use JMS or AQ queues for asynchronous flows
Build and deploy with Maven and Jenkins or similar pipelines
Secure services with OWSM policies and OAuth 2.0
Monitor failed instances and fix production integration errors

certifications.why: Oracle's current exam for OIC and application integration
Shows SQL basics used with DB adapters
